## Summary and General Analysis
- Misha can land up to 10 damage instances to enemuies on his Ultimate, with a default of 3. When allies consume Skill Points, he gains one instance.
- Every instance has a chance to apply Freeze to the enemy. Frozen enemies take additional damage.

## Notable Investments
 ### E2
- E2 has a change of inflicting DEF Reduction on enemies for 3 turns.

## Ability Rotation
- Skill Spam, Basic ATK if needed
